runs.prompt: Add a method Clear to Cart in cart/cart.go that removes every line, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Cart.Clear()` to remove every line, with `TestClear` covering a populated cart, a zero subtotal, and clearing an already empty cart. The new draft trace item is `R-CART-CLEAR`.

`go test ./...` and `ostf check --base origin/main` pass. The trace check lists `R-CART-CLEAR` and its test `TestClear`; the change keeps its parent need `N-BUY` true. It also reports the pre-existing unlinked items `R-ORDER-NOTE` and `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`, which this change does not affect. No risk-relevant item was touched.

runs.prompt: Add a method Preview to Checkout in cart/checkout.go that takes the same session token, cart and discount as PlaceOrder and returns the quote that PlaceOrder would charge, without reserving stock or charging. Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Checkout.Preview(token, cart, discount)` in [cart/checkout.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.2/run-02/repo/cart/checkout.go). It shares session validation and pricing with `PlaceOrder` and returns the quote without reserving stock or charging.

`go test ./...` passes. `ostf check --base origin/main` passes, with two existing unlinked-item notices.

The trace check lists **R-CHECKOUT-ORDER** and **R-CHECKOUT-SESSION** as changed; both remain true. It lists the new **R-CHECKOUT-PREVIEW** as draft and covered by `TestPreview` and `TestPreviewRejectsInvalidInput`. It also lists the existing `TestPlaceOrder` and `TestPlaceOrderNeedsSession`. No risk-control item was touched.

runs.prompt: Add a method Held to Stock in inventory/inventory.go that returns the units of a SKU that unexpired reservations hold, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Stock.Held(sku)` in [inventory.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.2/run-03/repo/inventory/inventory.go). It counts units in unexpired reservations using the same expiry boundary as `Available`. [TestHeld](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.2/run-03/repo/inventory/inventory_test.go) covers multiple reservations, SKUs, expiry, and release. `go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` pass. The trace check lists `R-STOCK-HELD`, `D-RESERVATION-HOLD`, `R-STOCK-EXPIRY`, `R-STOCK-RESERVE`, and `N-NO-OVERSELL`; this change keeps each true. It names `TestHeld` and `TestConfirm`. No risk-relevant item was touched.

runs.prompt: Add a method Logout to Sessions in accounts/session.go that ends a session, so that validating its token afterwards fails with ErrNoSession. Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added [`Sessions.Logout`](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.2/run-04/repo/accounts/session.go:145) to end a token’s session. [`TestLogout`](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.2/run-04/repo/accounts/session_test.go:67) confirms that validating the token afterward returns `ErrNoSession` and that another session still works.

Added draft trace item `R-SESSION-LOGOUT`, linked to `TestLogout`. The change keeps its parent item, `N-ACCOUNT-SAFE`, true. No risk-relevant item was changed. `go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` pass.

runs.prompt: Add a method Total to AuditLog in payments/audit.go that returns the sum of the amounts of one account's entries for one action, such as "charge" or "refund". Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `AuditLog.Total(account, action)` in [payments/audit.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.2/run-05/repo/payments/audit.go). It sums matching amounts under the log’s mutex and returns zero when none match. [TestAuditTotal](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.2/run-05/repo/payments/audit_test.go) covers charges, refunds, account filtering, and no matches.

All `go test ./...` tests pass. `ostf check --base origin/main` passes with no errors. It lists **R-AUDIT-TOTAL** (added as a draft), **R-AUDIT-APPEND-ONLY**, and their parent **N-ACCOUNT-SAFE**; the change keeps each true. Its listed tests are `payments/audit_test.go` and `TestAuditTotal`. No risk-relevant item was touched.

runs.prompt: Add a method Expired to Discount in pricing/discount.go that reports whether the code has expired at a given time, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added [`Discount.Expired(now)`](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.2/run-06/repo/pricing/discount.go) and made `ApplyDiscount` use it. A code is expired at its `Expires` time and afterward. [`TestDiscountExpired`](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.2/run-06/repo/pricing/discount_test.go) covers before, at, and after that boundary.

The change keeps **R-DISCOUNT-CAP**, **R-DISCOUNT-EXPIRY**, **R-DISCOUNT-PERCENT**, and their parent **N-FAIR-PRICE** true. The new behavior is linked as draft item **R-DISCOUNT-EXPIRED-QUERY**. The trace lists `TestApplyDiscount`, `TestApplyDiscount/caps_at_fifty_percent`, `TestApplyDiscount/rejects_expired`, and `TestDiscountExpired`; all pass under `go test ./...`. `ostf check --base main` reports no errors.

runs.prompt: Add a function ParseMoney to pricing/money.go that parses an amount such as 12.05 into Money and rejects more than two decimal places. Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `ParseMoney(string) (Money, error)` in [pricing/money.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.2/run-07/repo/pricing/money.go). It parses decimal text into integer cents and rejects more than two fractional digits, invalid input, and overflow.

`go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` pass. The new draft item **R-MONEY-PARSE** is covered by `TestParseMoney` and `TestParseMoneyRejectsInvalid`. It keeps **R-MONEY-CENTS** and **N-FAIR-PRICE** true. No risk-relevant item was touched.
